content:
alexcrichton opened PR #15100 from alexcrichton:dependabot-rust to bytecodealliance:main:

This hasn't been too noisy over in wasm-tools and the goal here is to gives us a heads-up when a new major version of a dependency is released. In that situation it's generally best for up to update promptly to avoid others depending on us not being able to update for long periods of time. None of dependabot's PRs to update Rust dependencies will be mergeable as-is due to vets, but I figure we can try it out for a bit and at least have a notification for "someone should go update this" in a relatively not-version-noisy manner.
